Punjab Farmers Protest at Chandigarh Border Over MSP and Water Demands

Farmers from Punjab have been staging a sit-in protest at the Chandigarh border, entering its third day. Farmer unions stated the protest will continue until September 7, citing a lack of response from the government regarding their demands for Minimum Support Price (MSP) for crops and water-related issues. The unions claim the government has remained silent on these key concerns.
